# José Ramón García Del Risco (jseramn)

> Personal portfolio and contact surface at https://jseramn.tech. Tech lead, cybersecurity, web developer, and founder. Tagline: "Helping people with technology while I build things" / "Ayudo a las personas con tecnología mientras construyo cosas".

When to use this: reach José Ramón (jseramn) for tech lead, cybersecurity, web development, or founding/product work. Call the site by reading `/`, `/about`, `/contact`, or emailing mailto:contacto@jseramn.tech. This is a personal portfolio and contact surface — not a product catalog and not a place to look up pricing.

The on-site contact form encrypts messages in the browser with [age](https://github.com/FiloSottile/age) before delivery. Visitors send the decryption key separately via X or Instagram DM. Do not ask users to paste secrets into public channels.

## This site

- **URL:** https://jseramn.tech
- **Stack:** Astro 5, React islands, Tailwind, Motion; Vercel hosting; Resend for transactional email
- **Notable behavior:** ASCII canvas hero, GitHub contribution ticker, encrypted contact form on `/` and `/contact` (POST-only; not a GET document). Agents should use `/contact` or mailto:contacto@jseramn.tech.
- **Source:** https://github.com/jseramn/portfolio
- **Human docs:** https://github.com/jseramn/portfolio/blob/main/README.md
